##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the mid-Atlantic and low pressure develops into England, bringing various weak fronts across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling north or northwest 2 to 4 tomorrow morning. Veering northeast 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, but smooth in places.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, gradually becoming mainly fair tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 3 to 5, soon veering east or northeast, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters Monday morning, settling Northerly later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
